# Prepend cell-run golden fixture
# Unicode 15.0.0 — UAX #29 GB9b: Prepend × [^(Control|CR|LF)]
#
# A Prepend character starts a grapheme cluster and absorbs the following
# non-control code point.  The cluster's width = the absorbed character's
# width.  A standalone Prepend at end-of-line has width=0.
#
# Without GB9b, Prepend+digit would be 2 clusters (Prepend=1 cell + digit=1 cell).
# With GB9b, Prepend+digit is 1 cluster (width=1, from the digit).
#
# Format: description | utf8 bytes (hex) | tab_width → total_cells | spans

# U+0600 Arabic Number Sign (D8 80, Cf Prepend) + '1' (31)
# 1 cluster: Prepend absorbs '1'; cluster width = 1 (narrow digit)
prepend_0600_1    | D8 80 31           | 4 → 1 | 0:3:1:T

# Adversarial: 'a' then Prepend+digit → 2 clusters
# 'a' (61) is cluster 1 [width=1]; U+0600 (D8 80) + '1' (31) is cluster 2 [width=1]
# This shows Prepend does NOT extend the preceding 'a' cluster
a_prepend_digit   | 61 D8 80 31        | 4 → 2 | 0:1:1:T 1:3:1:T

# Standalone Prepend at end of line: width=0, kind=combining
# U+0600 alone (D8 80) → no following char to absorb
lone_prepend      | D8 80              | 4 → 0 | 0:2:0:C

# Prepend at end of line before control: Prepend doesn't absorb C0 control
# U+0600 (D8 80) + BEL (07) → Prepend cluster {width=0} + control cluster {width=1}
prepend_before_ctl | D8 80 07          | 4 → 1 | 0:2:0:C 2:1:1:CTL
